<!--
Thanks for contributing to screencappy.

Two things worth checking before you hit Create:

- The PR title must be a valid Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `fix(stitch):`, ...).
  PRs are squash-merged, so the title becomes the commit on main that release-please
  reads to cut the next version. CI fails the PR if the title does not parse.
- Run the checks CI runs: `bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build`.

Open the PR as a draft and review your own diff first. It catches more than you expect.
-->
